info.title: My Wallet API
info.description: HTTP API for managing private investment wallets. Rate-limited responses include Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers.

get.summary: Search by stock symbol or company name
get.description: Returns up to 10 USD candidates and explicit reasons for excluded results. A profile is requested only when name or currency is missing. Live dispatch requires a configured shared quota reservation store.

get.summary: Get the latest available USD closing price on or before a trade date
get.description: Preserves the requested date and returns the effective quote date and exact-decimal unit price. Profile and history requests each consume a reserved unit. Searches at most five consecutive five-year windows; incomplete coverage is reported explicitly.

get.summary: Read the shared application provider request budget
get.description: Counts tracked outbound reservations across all users, including failed calls and retries. It is not the provider account balance. Reading consumes no quota. Returns configuration availability, local quota date, reset timezone and next reset instant.

post.summary: Create a wallet for the authenticated user

get.summary: Get one of the authenticated user’s wallets

patch.summary: Update one of the authenticated user’s wallets

delete.summary: Permanently delete one of the authenticated user’s wallets

get.summary: Read paginated wallet history, optionally filtered by instrument
get.description: Newest first by transaction date, creation timestamp and id. Exact totals and SELL realized P/L use the complete symbol ledger before pagination. BUY realized P/L is null. canDelete identifies the latest row for each wallet/instrument in this snapshot; DELETE rechecks eligibility under the write lock. An unknown symbol filter returns an empty list.

post.summary: Record an immutable USD stock trade and return its resulting share quantity
post.description: Preserves the entered date, quantity and unit price. BUY verifies stock classification and USD quote currency with one charged profile request. SELL uses stored instrument metadata without provider calls. Serializes creation and latest-only deletion and rejects chronological oversells with 409 INSUFFICIENT_HOLDING, including backdated re-entry that invalidates later sales. Editing is unsupported.

get.summary: Read ledger-only wallet totals and instrument holdings
get.description: A consistent owned-wallet snapshot, ordered by symbol. Includes closed positions with zero quantity and null average cost so realized P/L remains visible. Empty wallets return zero totals, no holdings and a null last transaction date. Amounts are unrounded decimal strings in USD. No live prices, current values, unrealized P/L or provider requests.

get.summary: Read ledger-only accounting for one instrument in an owned wallet
get.description: Returns remaining quantity, original acquisition cost of remaining FIFO lots, weighted-average remaining unit cost, total realized P/L and last transaction date. Closed positions remain readable. Symbols are case-insensitive. A symbol with no ledger in this wallet returns 404, even when shared instrument metadata exists.

get.summary: Read cached current values and FIFO unrealized P/L for an owned wallet
get.description: Returns unrounded USD decimal strings with per-position price dates and freshness. Retains stale prices. If an open position has no price, wallet current value, unrealized P/L and allocation percentages are null. Closed positions need no price and contribute zero current value. Reads never dispatch provider calls or request refreshes.

get.summary: Read cached valuation for one holding with its share of the complete wallet
Read shared refresh state for the owned wallet holdings without scheduling work

post.summary: Idempotently request shared refreshes for stale open holdings
post.description: Call after opening a wallet. Persists intent and returns without waiting for FMP. Repeated requests coalesce by symbol and preserve pending retries, active leases and terminal cooldowns. requestedSymbols reports persisted requests, not completed refreshes or quota reservations. Fresh and closed holdings are skipped. Poll refresh status or reread valuation for completion.

delete.summary: Permanently delete the latest transaction for its wallet and instrument
delete.description: Locks the owned wallet using the same protocol as creation, verifies latest eligibility by transaction date, creation timestamp and id, then hard-deletes and replays the remaining FIFO ledger atomically. Older entries return 409 CONFLICT without mutation. Missing or inaccessible resources return 404. Replay conflicts roll back deletion with 409 INSUFFICIENT_HOLDING. No audit copy is retained and no provider requests are made. Corrections use normal BUY/SELL creation after deletion.

204.description: The latest transaction was permanently deleted and the remaining ledger was replayed.
